title: 'Hundreds more' US agents head to Minneapolis, says Homeland Security Secretary
summary: Hundreds of additional federal agents are bound for Minneapolis after the killing of Renee Nicole Good in the Midwestern city by an Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) officer prompted mass protests, US Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem told Fox News on Sunday.
contentText: "Hundreds" of additional federal agents will soon head to Minneapolis despite widespread protests over an immigration officer's fatal shooting of Renee Nicole Good, 37, during a traffic stop, US Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem told Fox News on Sunday. Some 2,000 federal officers have already been dispatched to the Minneapolis-St. Paul area.
